name: nz-kiwisaver-esct
description: Use this skill for New Zealand KiwiSaver administration by an employer from 1 April 2026 and employer superannuation contribution tax (ESCT): automatic enrolment and its exceptions, employee deduction rates (3.5% default from 1 April 2026, the retained 4% default, temporary rate reductions), the gross salary or wages base, compulsory employer contributions, savings suspensions, unpaid leave and ACC, opt-outs and refunds, the ESCT rate threshold table and how to calculate ESCT on each contribution. Trigger on KiwiSaver employer, KiwiSaver deduction, employer contribution, opt out, savings suspension, ESCT, employer superannuation contribution tax. PAYE itself is in nz-employer-payroll.
